interpretation: Scalar encoder callback ABI only; original fresh baseline and matching rebuilt after callers/callbacks. CPU0 sequentialABBA. All samples and ordering edges retained. Small sweep is all registered min-fit/u64 carriers, not all carriers admitted by the API. Bulk units ns/value, casing ns/call. External Calico hashes and compiler source files were independently checked on the worker after measurement; see post-verification.
maintenance_review: cost-review/ inspects the retained worker objects and actual callers. Compile edge durations are observations across jobs/cache states, not a controlled build-time delta. Common instruction-body equality excludes relocation targets, data contents and final linked placement.

selection_curation.note: Git selection and local navigation changed; measured source, job, and full-bundle identities are unchanged.

units: CPU/real times are ns per benchmark iteration. ns_per_item uses the reported item rate; an item means what the benchmark counts, not necessarily a value or byte.
